text:
alice_cs: Customer acme-prod reporting 403s on /v1/generate in prod. Embeddings and rerank calls succeed. Customer says this started after we bulk-provisioned service tokens last week. P2 - customer in production.
alice_cs: Example repro from customer (redacted key):
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_prod_XXXXX\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-text-1","input":"Hello"}'
```
Response:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"insufficient_scopes","message":"missing: generate"}
```
eng_sam: looking now. Do you have the token id or tenant id? I can check provisioning logs.
alice_cs: token id (partial) sk_prod_123, tenant t-ACME-01. Also have a few other tenants showing similar symptoms.
eng_sam: checked provisioning service. The service token was created by bulk-import pipeline. Parsed scopes were: ["embeddings","rerank"] — generate missing. So server correctly enforces scopes, token lacks generation entitlement.
jordan_se: reproduced locally by running the CSV import flow with the same input. Looks like our scope normalizer treats semicolon/whitespace variants oddly; if the CSV cell had "embeddings; rerank; generate" the parser dropped the third scope when there was a trailing newline.
jordan_se: repro snippet from staging import log:
```
provisioner: parse_scopes(cell=\"embeddings; rerank; generate\n\") -> normalized=["embeddings","rerank"]
```
alice_cs: Customer asked for immediate fix or workaround — they can’t create a new token themselves due to SSO provisioning flow.
eng_sam: short-term workaround: create a personal API key for a tenant admin and give them generate permission, or ask engineering to add the missing scope to the affected service token. Long-term: fix parser in provisioner.
devops_maya: I can run a backfill to add "generate" for tokens missing it. Need an authoritative list of affected token ids/tenants. Will also coordinate rotations if we issue new keys.
alice_cs: attaching list of affected tenants in DM: t-ACME-01, t-FOOBAR-22, t-ORCH-07 (total 5). Please try to avoid rotating unless necessary — customer prefers minimal churn.
eng_sam: Plan:
1) Patch provisioner parser to trim newline/whitespace and split on multiple delimiters (PR in progress).
2) Run a targeted backfill script that appends "generate" to service token scopes when missing (no rotation; update entitlement only).
3) Notify customers and confirm.
eng_sam: @devops_maya I'll tag you on the PR. ETA for PR + deploy: EOD. Backfill run ~2h after deploy in a maintenance window.
devops_maya: ack. Will prepare backfill job and dry-run it against staging tokens. Also will create a runbook entry for future bulk imports.
infra-bot: deploy initiated for commit 2f9b7c7 (provisioner/parser-fix). CI job #4578 running.
eng_sam: Deploy succeeded, PR merged. Kicked off backfill dry-run in staging — matched 7 tokens. No unintended changes.
devops_maya: Running backfill in prod now targeted to tenant list from @alice_cs. Script will update scopes in place (no key rotation). Logging enabled, will post results.
devops_maya: Backfill finished: 5 tokens updated, added \"generate\" to scope list. No errors. Audit entries created.
eng_sam: Confirmed via internal audit logs: sk_prod_123 scopes -> ["embeddings","rerank","generate"].
alice_cs: Reached out to customer with patch details and asked them to retry. They attempted generate after ~10m and reported success.
alice_cs: Customer confirms /v1/generate now returns 200 and expected output. They requested a postmortem on provisioning parsing.
eng_sam: Will prepare short postmortem and update provisioning docs. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
alice_cs: Marking resolved from CS side. Closing thread once postmortem doc link is posted. :tada:
